origin.description: Add one prediction column for each model.

arguments.text: Named models. The name becomes the column.

origin.details: Columns are added in the order the models were named.
origin.value: The same rows, plus one column per model.
origin.example:
df <- data.frame(x = 1:5, y = c(1, 4, 3, 2, 5))
cat(spread_predictions(df, m1 = lm(y ~ x, data = df))$m1[1], "\n")
